description: This file declares functions for building Downlink Control Information (DCI) messages for various RNTI types in a 5G NR scheduler, including functions for SI-RNTI, P-RNTI, RA-RNTI, TC-RNTI, and C-RNTI, with specific configurations for uplink and downlink, HARQ processes, and search spaces.

methods.name: build_dci_f1_0_si_rnti
methods.description: Constructs DCI f1_0 message for SI-RNTI used in SIBs.

methods.name: build_dci_f1_0_p_rnti
methods.description: Constructs DCI f1_0 message for P-RNTI used in PCCHs, with overloads for different message types.

methods.name: build_dci_f1_0_ra_rnti
methods.description: Constructs DCI f1_0 message for RA-RNTI used in RAR.

methods.name: build_dci_f1_0_tc_rnti
methods.description: Constructs DCI f1_0 message for TC-RNTI, used in Msg4.

methods.name: build_dci_f1_0_c_rnti
methods.description: Constructs DCI f1_0 message for C-RNTI.

methods.name: build_dci_f1_1_c_rnti
methods.description: Constructs DCI f1_1 message for C-RNTI.

methods.name: build_dci_f0_0_tc_rnti
methods.description: Constructs DCI f0_0 message for TC-RNTI, used in Msg3 retransmissions.

methods.name: build_dci_f0_0_c_rnti
methods.description: Constructs DCI f0_0 message for C-RNTI.

methods.name: build_dci_f0_1_c_rnti
methods.description: Constructs DCI f0_1 message for C-RNTI.
